d: Saudi Arabia is facing repeated Houthi missile attacks, putting major cities and critical infrastructure on high alert. In this video, Firstpost examines Riyadh’s response, the activation of the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement with Turkey and Pakistan, and the support Ankara is offering as Saudi Arabia faces growing security threats. The video also looks at Pakistan’s response, including a military-produced song celebrating ties with Saudi Arabia and the new defence pact.
